redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/staleness.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: check mode must report an error, not 0:; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD, PWD; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: .venv - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own .venv and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: scripts/staleness.mjs: the direct-run block now picks the rejection handler by mode. With --check in argv, a rejection prints 'staleness.mjs: <stack>' to stderr and exits 2. Otherwise (hook mode) it still exits 0. checkMain/main are unchanged apart from a comment on the rethrow. tests/staleness.test.mjs: added s11, which preloads a --require module via NODE_OPTIONS that makes process.stdout.write throw a non-UsageError. It asserts check mode exits 2 with the message on stderr, and hook mode with the same preload exits 0 with empty stdout. I ran it before the fix and it failed (status 0). After the fix s11 passes. tests/staleness.test.mjs passes in full, and 'node --test' ran 219 tests, 219 pass, 0 fail. Dependants: hooks/hooks.json (hook mode still exits 0, unchanged), commands/check.md (documents exit 0 fresh/1 stale, still correct; exit 2 for errors was already the behaviour for usage errors), docs/design.md, skills/architecture-map/SKILL.md, tests/commands.test.mjs, tests/skill.test.mjs (all describe the script by path and exit codes that are unchanged; their tests pass in the full run). I did not open docs/design.md or SKILL.md.
outcome.descriptive: A check that crashes unexpectedly now exits 2 with the error printed instead of falsely reporting fresh; hook mode still always exits 0.
